claims.assertion: Mari Swaruu says Suzy-class jumps leave a detectable field disturbance for seconds or minutes; combat pilots can randomize jumps through space and time to evade pursuit.
claims.speaker: Mari Swaruu
claims.qualifiers: She calls the combined spatial and temporal maneuver Space Skipping.

claims.assertion: Mari Swaruu says Athena docked two Suzy craft through ventral hatches and linked their computers so the second ship mirrored the first ship's guidance.
claims.speaker: Mari Swaruu
claims.qualifiers: The link let Mari transfer aboard while her ship followed Athena's.
